name: Curler Fergus

intro.text: Hurry hard! Hurry hard! ... Sorry, that's not for you. That's for the stone. Though you could hurry too.

win: Good shot. That was a draw to the button. Or a battle. I forget.
after: The curling stones are made of granite from Ailsa Craig, a lonely island off the Ayrshire coast. They weigh about 20 kg.
